def: gift of God; zabdiel, the name of two Israelites

occurrences.text: Over the first course for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
And their brethren, mighty men of valour, an hundred twenty and eight: and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of one of the great men.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
